text_block_list.text: The Takarazuka Kinen is finally here.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
When Мэдзиро МакКуин sees Mejiro
Ryan's
confidence, she realizes that her
friend has finally
overcome her
weaknesses.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро Райан proudly credits her training
for how
she learned to believe in herself.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Finally, she's ready to fight for her
dream.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
